# INVESTMENT MEMORANDUM
**Comstock Resources, Inc. - Second Amendment to Credit Agreement**

---

## 1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

**Date of Agreement:** October 30, 2024

**Borrower/Company Overview:** Comstock Resources, Inc., a Nevada corporation operating in the oil and gas sector with natural gas production operations.

**Transaction Description:** Second Amendment to Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement originally dated November 15, 2022. The transaction involves Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. as Administrative Agent and a syndicate of 17 lenders including major financial institutions such as Bank of America, N.A., Capital One, Fifth Third Bank, Mizuho Bank, and others.

**Purpose of Financing:** Amendment to existing credit facility to (i) modify certain terms of the existing credit agreement and (ii) reaffirm the Borrowing Base at $2,000,000,000.

**Company Background:** Comstock Resources operates as an oil and gas company with subsidiaries including Comstock Oil & Gas, LLC and related entities. The company maintains proved developed producing (PDP) reserves and engages in natural gas production operations requiring periodic borrowing base redeterminations based on reserve valuations.

---

## 2. INVESTMENT HIGHLIGHTS & RISKS

### Key Strengths / Credit Positives:
• **Substantial Borrowing Base:** $2,000,000,000 borrowing base reaffirmed, indicating significant underlying asset value
• **Diversified Lender Syndicate:** 17-lender group including major financial institutions provides stability and liquidity
• **Asset-Backed Structure:** Credit facility secured by oil and gas reserves with periodic redetermination process
• **Hedging Requirements:** Mandatory hedging of 50% of anticipated natural gas production provides revenue protection
• **Experienced Management:** Senior management team with Roland O. Burns serving as President and CFO

### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:
• **Elevated Leverage Ratios:** Maximum Total Net Debt to EBITDAX ratio of 4.00x through Q1 2025, stepping down to 3.50x thereafter
• **Commodity Price Exposure:** Natural gas price volatility risk mitigated by mandatory hedging requirements during Specified Period
• **Restrictive Covenants:** Dividend restrictions during Specified Period until debt-to-EBITDAX ratio improves to below 2.00x
• **Higher Pricing During Specified Period:** Increased applicable margins during Specified Period (25bp increase across utilization tiers)
• **Operational Risk:** Oil and gas production subject to operational and regulatory risks typical of the industry
